steps.title: One canvas
steps.text: The seven steps run across the top, tools sit on the left rail and the selection's properties on the right. Press H over the stage to hide every panel.
steps.say: Seven steps across the top; the rail and the properties float over the stage. Press H to hide them.

steps.title: First-run card and Guide
steps.text: A brand-new stage offers three ways in: the demo scene, a script or a video. The Guide (?) walks through the real controls.

steps.title: Pitch Mode
steps.text: In the Director panel, press Pitch (or P) and talk the scene through: "Night. Rainy alley. A detective walks toward camera. A car's headlights sweep across him." Each sentence builds the set, cast and blocking, and FLUX 3 Klein sketches the beat. Lock it turns the beats into shots, each sketch as its first frame. Listening and the sketches run on the GPU in the full install.
steps.say: Pitch (P) in the Director panel: talk the scene through, the set builds itself beat by beat.

clips.label: Pitch Mode, live
clips.note: Recorded in the App: six spoken beats (macOS text-to-speech), the set building and a sketch per beat.

steps.title: The Director's Book
steps.text: Book in the top bar opens a binder page per scene: the cover sheet, lighting, the camera plan, a floor plan from the stage, a clay storyboard, and your shorthand notes filed by scene and line. It prints to a PDF binder.
steps.say: The Director's Book: a page per scene, built from the stage. Print makes the PDF binder.

steps.title: Real performance
steps.text: Select a person, then Real performance: record or import an actor with their voice. Their body, face and lip sync drive the character, and the voice stays on the take. Capture and render run on the GPU in the full install.
steps.say: A person is selected: Real performance… is on their panel.

clips.label: Actor, pose read, Hollywood result
clips.note: The actor is an LTX-generated test clip, not a real person. Mouth-open correlation with the actor r = 0.92.

steps.title: Full control: Parts
steps.text: Every object has Parts in its properties, and every channel keys on the timeline. Cars: doors, hood and trunk, headlights, brake lights, indicators, the police light bar, wipers, steering, suspension, finish, dirt and damage. Horses: head, neck, tail and gait. People: eyes (gaze keys), expression and props in hand. The states reach the prompts.
steps.say: The car is selected: open Parts › Doors or Lights, change one, then Key.

clips.label: LTX draft: full beam, driver's door open
clips.note: Frame 1 of a Draft from Parts alone: headlights full beam, driver's door at 70°. The prompt said "The sports car has headlights on full beam and the driver's door wide open".

steps.title: New gaits: run, climb on, gallop
steps.text: People walk, jog and run on planted feet; horses walk, trot, canter and gallop with pinned hooves; riders run in, climb on and post. The clay guide carries the cadence, and the take follows it.
steps.say: Press Play: the riders' horses gait by speed, feet planted.

clips.label: Hero: clay to final
clips.note: LTX-2.5 final, rendered on the clay blocking.

steps.title: Stunt dynamics
steps.text: Stunts are driven by a vehicle-dynamics simulation, not hand keys: a floored launch with a fishtail, a closed-loop donut, a handbrake 180. The stunt-sprung body rolls and pitches on its springs; the tyres smoke on dry ground and throw spray on wet.
steps.say: The red car is selected: pick a stunt, then Play. The keys stay editable.

clips.label: J-turn, Draft
clips.note: LTX-2.5 Draft on the simulated J-turn.

steps.title: The Director
steps.text: Press / (or Director in the top bar) and say what you want: "make it rain, push in on the hood". It shows a short plan, Apply runs it through the App's own controls, and every turn has Undo this. Its language model runs beside ComfyUI in the full install.

clips.label: Five typed commands
clips.note: Recorded in the App: five typed commands become plans, applied one undo step each.

steps.title: Presets: one click, one undo
steps.text: Press V for camera moves, lighting, looks, action, edit styles and recipes. Hover a camera move to preview it on the shot; a click applies it as one undo step.
steps.say: Presets (V): hover a camera move to preview it on the shot, click to apply it, Cmd+Z to undo.

steps.title: The Timeline
steps.text: The Edit tab is a real editing timeline: dissolves, dips and wipes, rubber-band keys, titles and subtitles, and sound on A1 to A4 with auto-duck. Generating sound and rendering MP4, ProRes or 9:16 run on the GPU in the full install.

clips.label: Night Run, cut on the Timeline
clips.note: Six real finals cut on the Timeline: fade up, a title, a dissolve and a wipe, sync sound and score, rendered at -14 LUFS.

steps.title: Hollywood quality
steps.text: Motion's Quality is Draft, Final or Hollywood, saved per shot. Hollywood refines at 2624 x 1408: real detail in skin, water and rain. Advanced (LTX) opens every LTX control and a ProRes 422 HQ master.

clips.label: Windshield: Final vs Hollywood
clips.note: The same frame of the In the car windshield shot, rendered at Final and at Hollywood.

steps.title: Takes that check themselves
steps.text: Every draft and final is checked on the CPU: black frames, freezes, jumps, smear, face drift and cars facing the wrong way. Chips sit on the Ladder and in Dailies, with a Follows your blocking score. The chips here are the server's real results for these takes.

steps.title: The phone is the viewfinder
steps.text: Scan a QR code and your phone shows the stage through the shot camera, and is the camera: aim it, pick a 14 to 135 mm prime, tap to focus, set the iris. REC lands the move on the shot. The phone bridge runs beside ComfyUI in the full install.

clips.label: Phone and desktop
clips.note: Real-time capture of both screens, nothing sped up.

steps.title: ScriptSync with the real dailies
steps.text: The sample script's desert, main street and beach scenes, with every take the GPU made on the lined script. Click a line and that take plays from that moment.

clips.label: ScriptSync
clips.note: Recorded in the App: click a coverage line and the take plays, cued to it.

steps.title: Seated cast, see-through glass
steps.text: People sit in their seats, and car glass reads as glass in Clay, Color and the video guides, so the cast shows through the windshield.

clips.label: Through the windshield (final)
clips.note: LTX-2.5 final from the In the car stage, seed 42.

steps.title: Lit lamps, and the fixed chase take
steps.text: Real-car bodies light their headlights and tail lights in Color, so the look still and the video know which end leads. The chase-cam take is re-rendered nose first.
steps.say: Color view: headlights lead, tail lights trail. Run ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion on the Chase cam shot to replay the fixed take.

steps.title: Horses and riders
steps.text: The rigged horse, with riders up in the saddle. Scene setup seats a script's riders on their horses.

clips.label: Riders draft
clips.note: LTX-2.5 draft of two riders, blocked on the stage.

steps.title: Live drags: climb, mount, pick up
steps.text: Drag Sam onto a crate and he climbs it. Over the horse, he mounts; drag him off and he dismounts. Walk him into a light box and press C to pick it up, C again to put it down.
steps.say: Drag Sam onto a crate, over the horse, or into a light box (then press C).

steps.title: Physics pushes, CPU or GPU
steps.text: Shove a crate into the others or into the carton tower: physics stays live while you edit. The Physics panel switches the solver; GPU (AVBD) falls back to the CPU where WebGPU can't start.

steps.title: The stunt picker
steps.text: Select a car, then Stunt: Reverse J-turn, Donut or Handbrake 180. The keys stay editable; the body rolls on its springs and the tyres smoke.
steps.say: The red car is selected: pick a stunt in its properties, then Play. ④ Frame and ⑤ Motion replay the real J-turn renders.

clips.label: J-turn final
clips.note: LTX-2.5 final with sound, from the FLUX 3 Klein frame chosen in ④ Frame.

steps.title: New sets
steps.text: Underwater reef, burning building, airplane cabin, train carriage and platform, runway and above the clouds. Each one here was set up by the App from a slugline; pick them from Scene, under New sets.

steps.title: Ripple edit and Pose follow
steps.text: ⑤ Motion › Follow: Ripple carries a frame-1 edit from Paint Studio through the whole clip; Pose drives LTX with the stage's skeletons. Both render on the GPU in the full install.

clips.label: Ripple: red jacket
clips.note: Left: the source clip. Right: frame 1 repainted, rippled through the clip with its motion kept.

clips.label: Pose follow
clips.note: Clay, layout follow and pose follow of the riders.

steps.title: DCC kit: Blender, Unreal, Maya, Nuke
steps.text: ⑦ Deliver › Download the DCC kit: an animated GLB, the camera and builder scripts for each app. Import world brings a whole environment in.
